scan_coverage.scope: Modified non-test JavaScript and TypeScript source files

manual_controls_verified: OAuth route telemetry excludes exception messages, tokens, codes, provider bodies, and account identifiers.
Import telemetry contains only format, bounded aggregate counts, safe database code, and support reference.
The import preflight is workspace-bound, membership-validated, and explicitly unavailable to anonymous callers.
Recovered row evidence is cross-checked against request hashes, workspace contacts, and contact-imported activity events.
Google OAuth finalization remains service-role only and persists each granted capability independently.
recommendation: PASS for static security patterns; database replay and authenticated Production smoke remain separate release gates.
